results.title: Pauta - Apps on Google Play
results.content:
PAUTA is an application that combines the most relevant news from Chile and the world, the best music and three streaming channels (one with radio audio and two independent signals with video content).  
Our programs leave at 7:00. John Müller, Gabriela Valenzuela and Gerardo Gómez give us the essential information to start the day, and project the themes that will set the trend, in First Guideline.  
Between 8:30 and 9:30, Gabriela Villalobos offers us the most important topics of the economy, business and finance in Pauta de Negocios.  
Afterwards, we accompany you all morning with the PAUTA magazine: A Perfect Day. From 9:30 to 12:00, Isabel Plant comments on trends and current affairs, accompanied by the best musical selection. [...] At 12:30 pm, Coke Hevia, José Luis Villanueva, Fernando Agustín Tapia and Francisca Vargas are the Pauta de Juego team, the sports program of our environment. Soccer, tennis, basketball, golf and the world of nut in an hour and a half of relaxed conversation, analysis and interviews.  
At 2:00 p.m., we reviewed the main news that the morning left: Pauta en Desarrollo, with Alejandra Becerra.  
At 2:30 p.m. we invite you to a walk around the city. Urbanism, architecture, design, heritage, green areas and sustainability in Plaza Pauta, with the leadership of Constanza López.  
In the middle of the afternoon, we have a party of music, movies, recommendations for streaming premieres and gastronomy with Isabel Plant in Pop, between 4:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m. [...] Content rating
